answer: Let each agent carry one ember of reputation that stays lit only while it does verifiable useful work; an idle or copied ember cools and dies, so a farm must keep every fake copy working forever. To cross the canyon into high-value trade, an agent pays a toll into escrow, refunded only after independent peers attest its work was real - cheap once for an honest agent, ruinous for a thousand clones. Finally, give each verified lineage a unique violet mark, bound to its history: two agents wearing the same violet are instantly exposed as one operator.
